parameter.name: Ctrl
parameter.help: Select Single pole operation or 3 pole operation

parameter.name: OPCUR
parameter.help: Select Yes to open the breaker at any current, if not breaker will not open until the current is below the chopping limit

parameter.name: ENAB
parameter.help: Select Yes to No to enable/disable pre-insertion resistance

parameter.name: DisPQ

IVD1_1 = E_BtoI(OPENBR($Br(1),$SS)) + E_BtoI(OPENBR($BrP(1),$SS)) IVD1_2 = E_BtoI(OPENBR($Br(2),$SS)) + E_BtoI(OPENBR($BrP(2),$SS)) IVD1_3 = E_BtoI(OPENBR($Br(3),$SS)) + E_BtoI(OPENBR($BrP(3),$SS)) #ENDIF #ENDIF NRTCF = NRTCF + 1 IF (FIRSTSTEP .OR. IVD1_3)) THEN CALL PSCAD_AGI2(ICALL_NO,$#Component,IVD1_3,"BOpen3") ENDIF #IF ENAB == 0 #IF View==0 STORI(IVD1_4+0) = 2*E_BtoI(OPENBR($BrA,$SS)) STORI(IVD1_4+1) = 2*E_BtoI(OPENBR($BrB,$SS)) STORI(IVD1_4+2) = 2*E_BtoI(OPENBR($BrC,$SS)) #ELSE STORI(IVD1_4+0) = 2*E_BtoI(OPENBR($Br(1),$SS)) STORI(IVD1_4+1) = 2*E_BtoI(OPENBR($Br(2),$SS)) STORI(IVD1_4+2) = 2*E_BtoI(OPENBR($Br(3),$SS)) #ENDIF #ELSE #IF View==0 STORI(IVD1_4+0) = E_BtoI(OPENBR($BrA,$SS)) + E_BtoI(OPENBR($BrPA,$SS)) STORI(IVD1_4+1) = E_BtoI(OPENBR($BrB,$SS)) + E_BtoI(OPENBR($BrPB,$SS)) STORI(IVD1_4+2) = E_BtoI(OPENBR($BrC,$SS)) + E_BtoI(OPENBR($BrPC,$SS)) #ELSE STORI(IVD1_4+0) = E_BtoI(OPENBR($Br(1),$SS)) + E_BtoI(OPENBR($BrP(1),$SS)) STORI(IVD1_4+1) = E_BtoI(OPENBR($Br(2),$SS)) + E_BtoI(OPENBR($BrP(2),$SS)) STORI(IVD1_4+2) = E_BtoI(OPENBR($Br(3),$SS)) + E_BtoI(OPENBR($BrP(3),$SS)) #ENDIF #ENDIF #OUTPUT INTEGER SBRA {IVD1_1} #OUTPUT INTEGER SBRB {IVD1_2} #OUTPUT INTEGER SBRC {IVD1_3}
